title: task-event-log
rawUserRequest: Implement Work Item 14 task-event-log from the Task Outcome Report extension: add append-only JSONL event recording with finding fingerprints, corrections/supersession, and safe validation tests.

declaredIntent.summary: Provide the append-only event evidence boundary consumed by later Task Outcome generators and validators.

outOfScope: Outcome generation, validation CLI, Markdown rendering, Cockpit Status, PR summary, archive, or release integration
Editing or rewriting existing event records

sources.reason: Canonical event types, append-only rule, correction/supersession, and fingerprint requirements.
WI13 report contract that later generators consume.

riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item adds a small standard-library event append/validation boundary; later consumers must not treat corrected historical records as silently edited.

executionDecision.reason: Event types, append-only storage, fingerprint uniqueness, and correction/supersession boundaries are explicit.

preReviewWarnings: Review append-only behavior, correction relationships, fingerprint recurrence, privacy, and malformed-line handling.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: `scripts/ai_task_event_log.py` appends one validated JSON event per line without rewriting prior records and creates parent directories safely.
Supported event types include finding, risk, warning, confirmation, stop, resume, resolution, risk-accepted, check-pass-after-fix, prevention, completed, and cancelled.
Finding events require a deterministic fingerprint built from checker ID, reason code, affected resource, and evidence subject; a later post-fix recurrence is accepted as a new event.
Corrections and supersessions require explicit referenced event IDs and preserve the original record; malformed events, duplicate IDs, invalid types, and missing fingerprints are rejected.
Focused tests and full AI/project quality and lifecycle checks pass; outcome generation/validation/rendering remain out of scope.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: Later Task Outcome reports need durable evidence for findings, stops, decisions, and resolutions. A free-form log would allow silent history edits, duplicate findings, or corrections that cannot be reconstructed.
constraints: Use append-only JSONL and never rewrite prior event lines.
Keep event facts English-keyed and privacy-safe; do not persist secrets or unsupported scores.
Keep generation and validation consumers in later Work Items.
intent.rationale: A small validated event writer gives WI15+ one reconstructable evidence stream while preserving correction history and allowing recurrence after a fix.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Append valid event and reconstruct lines

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
